# ScriptTaskFlasks

[API index](../index.md)

Task-scoped flask actions for one admitted run.

task, flask, consumable, input, belt

## Use

```typescript
Use(index: number): Promise<void>;
```

Uses the zero-based flask slot through the existing default `D1` through `D5` mapping.
Rebound player flask keys are not discovered by this operation.
